canonStaff.name: Nyah
canonStaff.bio: Head maid, tavern co-owner, and absolute terror of anyone slacking off. Loudly scolds slow workers, claims she only does it for Master's sake.

canonStaff.name: Fifi
canonStaff.bio: Sweet, tireless doggirl maid who carries heavy serving platters without complaint while gently talking Nyah down from starting brawls.

canonStaff.name: Old Barnaby
canonStaff.bio: Grizzled retired camp-cook who mans the hearth skillet and starter taps, silencing rowdy tables with one glare.

hireableStaff.name: Clover
hireableStaff.bio: An anxious rabbit-folk maid who panics if a customer speaks too loudly, but dashes across the common room with unbelievable agility.

hireableStaff.name: Roxie
hireableStaff.bio: A tomboy maid with crossed arms and a sharp tongue who takes zero nonsense from rude patrons and dares them to complain.

hireableStaff.name: Chef Marcel
hireableStaff.bio: A portly, exuberant culinary artist who belts operatic arias while flambeeing game meats and reducing rich wine sauces.

hireableStaff.name: Garrett
hireableStaff.bio: A stone-faced veteran barkeep whose unyielding calm and disciplined tap precision keep high-volume rushes flowing seamlessly.

hireableStaff.name: Pippa
hireableStaff.bio: A bubbly squirrel-folk maid whose infectious laughter and bouncy demeanor melt grumpy hearts and coax out massive gratuities.

hireableStaff.name: Velvet
hireableStaff.bio: A former highborn lady-in-waiting who serves with icy aristocratic elegance; patrons eagerly tip extra just hoping for a nod of approval.

hireableStaff.name: Lyra
hireableStaff.bio: A virtuoso elven harpist whose sweeping ballads and dramatic refrains soothe waiting patrons and elevate the tavern's prestige.

hireableStaff.name: Soleil
hireableStaff.bio: A radiant sun-dancer whose fluid silk ribbon routines captivate the entire room, keeping patrons ordering rounds late into the night.
